leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a React Server Component to fetch data directly on the server
Configure a Next.js application to use Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for dynamic content
Apply Static Site Generation (SSG) to pre-render pages at build time
Manipulate component behavior by switching between client and server rendering strategies
Integrate Server Components with Client Components to create hybrid applications
Construct a page that demonstrates the performance differences between SSR and SSG
Update existing React components to leverage server-side data fetching capabilities
lessonTitle: React Server Components & SSR vs SSG
